# SpinComputeBondEnergyTriangleLatticeProjectedFromKagome

SpinComputeBondEnergyTriangleLatticeProjectedFromKagome, version 0.01

Usage: SpinComputeBondEnergyTriangleLatticeProjectedFromKagome [options] 

Options:

system options:
    -i, --input-state : name of the file corresponding to the state |Psi_R> (the order parameter being <Psi_L|c^+c^+|Psi_R>
